67: Caterpillar, born in Peoria, Illinois: giant yellow bulldozers and an earth-moving excavator carving a canyon road under a big prairie sky, a mining haul truck, dust clouds, Caterpillar yellow and black.
71: Starbucks, born at Pike Place Market in Seattle: a rainy Seattle harbour at dawn, a Puget Sound ferry and a two-tailed siren mermaid rising from the green waves holding a steaming coffee cup, deep green and cream.
75: Coinbase, a San Francisco crypto exchange: a giant glowing blue coin rising over the Golden Gate Bridge and the San Francisco hills at night, blue light rays, cobalt blue and white.
76: Strategy, the company that stacks bitcoin, from Tysons, Virginia: a heroic businessman on top of a towering mountain of gold coins stacking one more coin, a fortress vault behind, orange and black.
77: Chevron, born in California oil fields: an offshore oil platform in a stormy Gulf sea under lightning, a tanker ship, red and deep blue.
79: AstraZeneca, British-Swedish medicine maker from Cambridge, England: a gothic Cambridge college quadrangle at dusk with a glowing laboratory, scientists in white coats holding glowing flasks, a DNA helix in the sky, purple and gold.
80: Exxon Mobil, from Texas: a towering oil refinery and drilling derricks at a blazing red sunset over the Texas plains, a red winged horse in the clouds, red and deep blue.
